chain.title: Bench of Small Discoveries
chain.desc: The mod's only workstation: it shows a relic's level, quality and ability tree and spends leveling points to upgrade abilities.

chain.title: A Strap With Ambitions
chain.desc: A belt-slot relic seeded into village-tagged chest loot, including the fletcher house table.

chain.title: The Tracker's Cinch
chain.desc: Another belt-slot relic drawn from the same village loot pool as the Leather Belt.

chain.title: Ammunition Worn on the Back
chain.desc: A back-slot relic from village loot; its model has four fill stages plus a broken state.

chain.title: A Whistle the Stable Answers
chain.desc: Pulled from both the village pool and the anthropogenic pool of mineshaft, city and stronghold chests.

chain.title: The Joint That Never Runs Out
chain.desc: A village-loot relic with ten carved-away model stages; it regenerates charges and can be infused with a potion effect.

chain.title: Wheels Under the Boots
chain.desc: A feet-slot relic sitting in the village and anthropogenic loot pools.

chain.title: A Door Home in Your Palm
chain.desc: From the anthropogenic pool of mineshaft, city and stronghold chests; its Wormhole ability returns the bearer to their respawn point.

chain.title: Cloth Cut From Night
chain.desc: A back-slot relic found in the same abandoned-mineshaft, city and stronghold loot family.

chain.title: A Signpost Between Places
chain.desc: Anthropogenic loot again; the last of the relics seeded into human-made underground structures.

chain.title: Bottled Progress
chain.desc: Throwable experience that feeds relic levels directly instead of the player's own bar.

chain.title: Steps That Do Not Sink
chain.desc: The aquatic pool covers any chest table matching water, ocean, river, ship or aqua, plus Buried Treasure.

chain.title: Sting Worn as Jewellery
chain.desc: A necklace-slot relic from the same shipwreck, ocean ruin and buried treasure pool.

chain.title: Warmth for the Fist
chain.desc: The cold pool: taiga, snowy and glacial chest tables plus the Igloo chest.

chain.title: Blades for a Frozen Floor
chain.desc: A feet-slot relic from the same cold-biome loot family as the Wool Mitten.

chain.title: A Pouch of Living Dust
chain.desc: The jungle pool, covering jungle and temple chest tables; it occupies the charm slot.

chain.title: Sanctity and Its Opposite
chain.desc: The desert pool of pyramid and sand-structure chests; its Belief ability toggles between healing allies and burning the undead.

chain.title: Fire Kept in Glass
chain.desc: The Nether pool, matching fortress, lava, magma and burn chest tables plus the Ruined Portal chest.

chain.title: Signet of the Piglin Halls
chain.desc: A ring-slot relic restricted to bastion and piglin chest tables.

chain.title: A Kick Between Wings
chain.desc: The End pool: End City and End Ship chests, plus Stronghold tables through the same 'end' match.

notes: Item set = 119 stems of assets/relics/models/item/*.json intersected with item./block. keys across every assets/*/lang/en_us.json (31 ids). The other 88 model stems are per-relic level and broken-state variants (aqua_walker_0, shadow_glaive_3, *_broken) and a group of models with no lang entry at all in 0.8.0.13 - camouflage_ring, delay_ring, fragrant_flower, ghost_skin_talisman, lucky_horseshoe, old_boot, scarab_talisman, slime_heart, soul_devourer, spider_necklace, stellar_catalyst and blank_rune. Those twelve were DROPPED as unverifiable: no item.relics.* key exists for any of them in this jar, so they are either unregistered or registered without a translation, and a quest referencing them could not resolve a name. Relics ships no recipe files; acquisition is a single global loot modifier (data/relics/loot_modifiers/relic_loot.json registered through data/forge/loot_modifiers/global_loot_modifiers.json). The per-relic loot pool was read out of it/hurts/sskirillss/relics/items/relics/base/data/loot/misc/LootCollections.class, whose regexes define eleven pools: VILLAGE (chests/*village*), BASTION (*bastion|piglin*), NETHER (*nether|hell|lava|magma|fire|burn|fortress* plus minecraft:chests/ruined_portal), JUNGLE (*jungle|temple*), DESERT (*desert|sand|pyramid*), AQUATIC (*water|ocean|river|ship|aqua* plus buried_treasure), PILLAGE (*pillag|outpost* plus woodland_mansion), COLD (*taiga|cold|winter|snow|ice|glac* plus igloo_chest), SCULK (*warden|sculk|echo* plus ancient_city and ancient_city_ice_box), ANTHROPOGENIC (*mineshaft|city|stronghold*) and END (*end|warp*). Each relic class names its pools: blazing_flask/space_dissector/magma_walker/rage_glove/reflection_necklace NETHER, bastion_ring BASTION, elytra_booster/enders_hand/chorus_inhibitor END, shadow_glaive SCULK+END, aqua_walker/amphibian_boot/drowned_belt/jellyfish_necklace AQUATIC, wool_mitten/ice_skates/ice_breaker COLD, spore_sack JUNGLE, holy_locket DESERT, horse_flute/roller_skates VILLAGE+ANTHROPOGENIC, magic_mirror/midnight_robe/spatial_sign ANTHROPOGENIC, infinity_ham/arrow_quiver/hunter_belt/leather_belt VILLAGE. The first two collections are taken verbatim from data/curios/tags/items/*.json: collection 1 is the six-relic feet tag, collection 2 is every relic in the back, belt, necklace, hands, ring and charm tags; collection 3 is the remainder, which carry no Relics-supplied curio slot tag. moddb agreement: all 26 moddb entries are inside the verified 31, and the broad early-to-late shape matches (elytra_booster is the one clash - moddb puts it first at pos 0.146 while its loot pool is End City and End Ship chests, so this chain places it last; moddb's ordering there reflects quest-page layout, not gating).
